summary: Completed E2E testing of WatchNexus after C# backend migration. All requested features verified working: login, sidebar restructuring with collapsible Settings menu, folder browsing API, and sidebar tab visibility toggles.

login.details: Login with test@test.com / password authenticates and redirects to dashboard correctly

sidebar_structure.details: Security, VPN Portal, Lib Manager, Browse Media, Log Viewer, System, Marketplace are correctly UNDER Settings collapsible submenu (not at top level). All 7 admin items found under Settings.

settings_expand_collapse.details: Clicking chevron next to Settings correctly expands/collapses the admin sub-items

settings_general_page.details: /settings page loads General Settings with Paths & Storage, Sidebar Tabs, and Preferences tabs

sidebar_tabs_section.details: Settings > General > Sidebar Tabs shows all tabs in 3 groups: Media (10 items), Gadgets (5 items), Admin (7 items including Security, VPN Portal, Lib Manager, Browse Media, Log Viewer, System, Marketplace)

folder_browsing_api.details: /api/filesystem/browse returns directory listing with current_path, items, drives, parent_path, os_type, media_files_in_current. Tested both default path and /tmp path successfully.

api_libraries.details: /api/libraries returns array with auth token. CRUD operations verified.

tab_visibility_toggle.details: Toggling Security tab off in Settings > Sidebar Tabs hides it from sidebar. Toggling back on restores it. Changes sync to account.

critical_code_review_comments: C# backend migration successful - all core APIs working correctly
Sidebar correctly restructured with admin items under collapsible Settings menu
Folder browsing API fully functional with proper response structure
seed_data_creation: None required - test user exists in SQLite
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features verified working after C# backend migration. VPN and qBittorrent integrations are MOCKED. The backend runs via 'watchnexus-server' supervisor program (Python 'backend' is stopped). JWT tokens use WatchNexus issuer/audience.

mocked_apis.vpn_wireguard: VPN WireGuard control (wg-up, wg-down) returns mock responses
mocked_apis.qbittorrent: qBittorrent integration returns mock disconnected status
mocked_apis.gadgets: Weather, radio, podcasts return stub data
